info.title: WIB Middleware API
info.description:
Backend API contract for the myAccount React SPA.
This middleware sits between the React frontend and the legacy Symfony 3.4 backend (asigurari.ro).

## Authentication
- **Login** returns either full tokens (access_token + refresh_token) or a pre_auth_token when 2FA is required.
- **Access tokens** are short-lived RS256 JWTs (15 min). Send as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`.
- **Refresh tokens** are opaque strings (7-day TTL). Send in the POST body to `/api/auth/refresh`.
- **Pre-auth tokens** are short-lived JWTs (5 min, scope=pre_auth) used only for the 2FA verification step.

## Naming Convention
- **Request bodies**: snake_case for multi-word fields (e.g. `refresh_token`, `pre_auth_token`, `new_password`).
- **Response bodies**: camelCase (e.g. `accessToken`, `policyNumber`, `createdAt`).
- This is documented per-field in each schema. The frontend should follow these conventions exactly.

## Error Format
All errors follow this structure:
```json
{
  "error": {
    "code": "MACHINE_READABLE_CODE",
    "message": "Human-readable description.",
    "details": { "field": ["Validation message."] }
  }
}
```
The `details` key is only present for `VALIDATION_ERROR` responses.

## Rate Limiting
Sensitive endpoints are rate-limited per IP. When exceeded, a `429 TOO_MANY_REQUESTS` error is returned.

## Error Codes Reference
| Code | HTTP | Description |
|------|------|-------------|
| INVALID_CREDENTIALS | 401 | Wrong email or password |
| INVALID_PASSWORD | 400 | Wrong current password (change/disable 2FA) |
| INVALID_REFRESH_TOKEN | 401 | Expired or revoked refresh token |
| INVALID_RESET_CODE | 400 | Wrong or expired OTP code |
| INVALID_RESET_TOKEN | 400 | Wrong or expired reset token |
| INVALID_TWO_FACTOR_CODE | 400 | Wrong TOTP/email OTP code |
| TWO_FACTOR_REQUIRED | 200 | 2FA step needed (returns pre_auth_token) |
| USER_ALREADY_EXISTS | 409 | Email or username already taken |
| TOO_MANY_REQUESTS | 429 | Rate limit exceeded |
| VALIDATION_ERROR | 422 | Request body validation failed (see details) |
| SAME_PASSWORD | 422 | New password same as current |
| INVALID_2FA_METHOD | 422 | Method must be "totp" or "email" |
| INVALID_PRE_AUTH_TOKEN | 422 | Invalid or expired pre-auth token |
| POLICY_NOT_FOUND | 404 | Policy not found or access denied |
| QUOTE_NOT_FOUND | 404 | Quote not found or access denied |
| NOTIFICATION_NOT_FOUND | 404 | Notification not found or access denied |
| REMINDER_NOT_FOUND | 404 | Reminder not found or access denied |
| SESSION_NOT_FOUND | 404 | Session not found or access denied |
| UNAUTHORIZED | 401 | Missing or invalid JWT |
| FORBIDDEN | 403 | Insufficient permissions |
| NOT_FOUND | 404 | Route not found |

post.description:
Authenticates the user via email + password. Handled by the `json_login` firewall.

**Without 2FA**: returns `access_token`, `refresh_token`, and a `user` summary.
**With 2FA enabled**: returns `requires_2fa: true`, a short-lived `pre_auth_token`, and the `two_factor_method`.
The client must then call `POST /auth/two-factor` with the pre-auth token and TOTP/email code.

Rate limited: 5 attempts/minute per IP.

get.description: Returns the RSA public key used for JWT signature verification. Used by the legacy Symfony 3.4 backend.

post.description:
Creates a new user account. If a matching legacy user is found by username, the account is automatically
linked and profile data (person, contact, address, company) is hydrated from the legacy system.

On success, returns tokens immediately (user is auto-logged-in).
Accepts both camelCase (`firstName`) and snake_case (`first_name`) for backward compatibility.

Rate limited: 10 registrations/hour per IP.

username.description: Derived from email prefix if omitted

post.description:
Second step of the login flow when 2FA is enabled. The client submits the pre-auth token
received from POST /auth/login along with the 6-digit TOTP or email OTP code.

On success, returns full `access_token` and `refresh_token`.

Rate limited: 5 attempts/5 minutes per IP.

Exchanges a valid refresh token for a new access_token + refresh_token pair.
The old refresh token is consumed (single-use). If the token is invalid, expired,
or already revoked, returns 401.

Rate limited: 10 requests/minute per IP.

refresh_token.description: Opaque refresh token from login/previous refresh

post.description: Revokes the current session's refresh token and session record. Requires a valid JWT.

Sends a 6-digit OTP to the user's email address. Always returns success even if the email
is not registered (to prevent email enumeration).

Rate limited: 3 requests/hour per IP.

200.description: OTP sent (or silently ignored if email not found)

message.example: If an account exists for this email, a reset code has been sent.

post.description:
Validates the 6-digit OTP sent via email. On success, returns a one-time `reset_token`
that must be used with POST /auth/reset-password.

Rate limited: 5 attempts/15 minutes per IP.

Sets a new password using the reset token obtained from POST /auth/verify-reset-code.
Revokes all existing refresh tokens for the user (forces re-login on all devices).

Initiates 2FA setup. For `method=totp`, returns a TOTP secret and provisioning URI (for QR code).
The client must then call POST /auth/2fa/confirm with a valid TOTP code to activate it.
For `method=email`, 2FA is enabled immediately using email-based OTP codes.

provisioningUri.description: otpauth:// URI for QR code generation

message.example: Email two-factor authentication has been enabled.

post.description: Verifies the first TOTP code to confirm the secret is set up correctly. After this call, 2FA is fully active.

Resends the 2FA email OTP code during the login flow. Requires a valid pre_auth_token
and only works when the user's 2FA method is "email".

Rate limited: 3 requests/10 minutes per IP.

message.example: A new verification code has been sent to your email.

422.description: Invalid pre-auth token or wrong 2FA method

post.description: Disables 2FA for the authenticated user. Requires current password for confirmation.

get.description: Returns aggregated counts and highlights for the authenticated user.

Bearer.description: RS256 JWT access token (15 min TTL).
